content: Only event - based error monitors shall implement the callback service <Mip>_InitMonitorForEvent<EventName>. [Note] The BSW module Dem calls an implemented callback service <Mip>_InitMonitorForEvent<EventName> to trigger the re - initialization of an event - based error monitor depending on the EnableConditions or ControlDTCSe ttings. The re - initialization reason is passed by the parameter InitMonitorReason.
